data.name: Kumailah
data.gender_notes: Kumailah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kumailah is derived from the Arabic word 'kamil' which means complete, perfect, or whole. The name Kumailah carries the meaning “Complete” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Kumailah usually hope their child will grow to embody complete and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The one who is complete in faith and deeds.
data.etymology: Kumailah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Complete.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kumailah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: كميلة
in_arabic.long_meaning: كميلة هو اسم عربي مشتق من الكلمة العربية القديمة كميل، وتعني الحب والرحمة والتعاطف. ويستخدم هذا الاسم في القرآن الكريم في سورة الإسراء: "فَكَم مِنْ مُنزِلٍ جَنى" (الإسراء: 7). ويُعد كميلة اسمًا مشهورًا في الثقافة العربية، حيث يُعتبر رمزًا للعاطفة والمودة. وقد يُستخدم كميلة أيضًا في الأسماء الشخصية لفتح النفس والقلب للآخرين.

in_urdu.name: كمیلہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: كمیلہ نام کا تعلق ہے کلامی سے جو پیار اور دوسروں کے ساتھ تعاون کا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے پیار اور دوسروں پر رحمت کا مظاہرہ۔ یہ نام ہیجائیم کے پہلو سے بھی جڑا ہوا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: कुमैलाह
in_hindi.long_meaning: कुमैलाह नाम का अर्थ है प्रेम,दया,सहयोग। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से आया है और यह मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत प्रसिद्ध है। इस नाम का उपयोग मुस्लिम परिवारों में बच्चों के नामकरण के लिए किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: كمیلې
in_pashto.long_meaning: كمیلې د پياړه او د ګډون په معنا لري چې داسې يو څوک چې د ټولو سره پياړه کوي، نو هغه د دښمنو پوري پياړه کوي او د ټولو سره د ګډون کوي.

in_english.name: Kumailah
in_english.meaning: love, compassion, cooperation, kindness, and generosity
in_english.long_meaning: Kumailah is an Arabic name that means love, compassion, cooperation, kindness, and generosity. Derived from the Arabic root k-m-l, Kumailah is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Al-Isra (17:7) as "Fakam min munzilin janee". This name is highly regarded in Arabic culture, symbolizing the qualities of affection and empathy. Kumailah is often chosen as a given name to foster a sense of openness and receptivity to others.

data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic context, the name Kumailah holds a deep spiritual significance as it represents the idea of seeking and attaining perfection in one's belief and actions. It serves as a reminder to strive towards becoming a complete and whole human being, in accordance with Islamic teachings. Thus, the name Kumailah can inspire a sense of purpose, motivation, and self-improvement in the person who bears it.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Kumailah is believed to have derived from the Arabic word "Al-Kumail," meaning "The Mountain of the Moon," reflecting the spiritual journey towards inner wisdom and enlightenment, as in the tale of Prophet Khidr and Kumail, where the latter sought knowledge beyond the visible world.
